caseStudies.title: Loopwell: The Space for Well-being

cover.alt: Loopwell meditation room interior showing serene design and calming atmosphere

caseStudies.objective: Loopwell was turning an empty building in Montclair, New Jersey into a wellness and event space. The brand and website needed to introduce the space and support events, memberships, reservations, and payments.
intro: I helped develop Loopwell's visual identity and created its promotional materials, video edits and motion assets. I designed and implemented landing pages and helped design and develop the event and membership website, adding custom integrations and scripts around its operational needs. Event teams, instructors and wellness partners contributed to the productions and experiences this work supported.

contribution.summary: I helped develop Loopwell's logo and visual identity, designed promotional materials and landing pages, edited video, and created motion and paid social ads.
responsibilities: Website design, custom integrations and scripts
deliverables: Event films, motion and social ads

caseStudies.title: Drone Drop Pop-up

cover.alt: Drone delivering Bahlsen leibniz package to a surprised person on city street during marketing event

caseStudies.objective: Bahlsen wanted to introduce its refreshed brand and biscuit range through a local activation, then carry that event into a wider digital campaign.
intro: The campaign brought Bahlsen products to shoppers through drone deliveries in Montclair. I contributed to pre-production, edited the footage, designed promotional materials and paid social ads, and created motion assets. I also designed and implemented the landing pages. Teasers and follow-up content connected the live event to a coordinated digital campaign that continued after the drones landed.

contribution.summary: I designed promotional materials and landing pages, edited the event footage, and created motion and paid social ads for Bahlsen's drone-delivery pop-up.
deliverables: Promotional print materials and landing pages

sections.title: Planning and editing the live event
paragraphs: I contributed to the event's pre-production alongside the creative and production teams, including rough storyboards, shot planning and coordination with the camera crew and drone operators. The live activation gave us real reactions and footage to build the campaign around; I edited those moments into promotional content.

caseStudies.title: Mercedes-Benz & Genesis Marketing

cover.alt: Mercedes-Benz AMG driving on a scenic tropical road

caseStudies.objective: Benzel-Busch needed ongoing advertising for its Mercedes-Benz and Genesis dealerships. The work had to stay consistent across print, digital, social, commercials, and landing pages while giving the dealership a presence beyond standard manufacturer assets.
intro: I designed promotional materials and paid social ads, edited commercials, created motion graphics, and designed and implemented landing pages. The work gave Benzel-Busch's Mercedes-Benz and Genesis campaigns a consistent presence across channels. For the broader website rebuild, I collaborated with a development partner on the WordPress platform.

contribution.summary: I designed campaign materials and landing pages, edited commercials, and created motion and paid social ads for Benzel-Busch's Mercedes-Benz and Genesis campaigns.
deliverables: Landing pages and website design contributions

caseStudies.title: Fuel Your Fitness Fire

cover.alt: Blauner Fitness promotional campaign featuring at-home personal training services

caseStudies.objective: Blauner Fitness was introducing new at-home training services and needed an updated website and campaign materials to explain the offer and encourage consultation inquiries.
intro: I worked with the founder to develop strategies for new services, then used updated photography and brand assets to redesign the website and supporting materials. Dedicated service pages, an FAQ and a consultation form gave prospective clients a clearer path to inquiry. Social campaigns and direct mail supported the launch over six months.

contribution.summary: I worked directly with the founder on campaign strategy, refreshed brand materials and website design to introduce Blauner Fitness's new at-home services.

caseStudies.title: Secret Stash

cover.alt: Bahlsen snack advertising campaign themed around at-home lockdown humor

caseStudies.objective: Bahlsen wanted to introduce more U.S. shoppers to its biscuits through a playful digital campaign. The work later had to adapt to changes in everyday life during COVID lockdowns.
intro: I edited a 30-second commercial and designed supporting digital assets around the playful idea of hiding favorite snacks. When COVID changed the context after filming, the campaign was reframed around sharing snacks during lockdown. I adapted the video and digital creative to support that shift alongside a student film competition and customer content.

contribution.summary: I edited video and designed digital and social creative for a campaign about hiding favorite snacks, adapting the assets as the campaign shifted to a lockdown audience.
responsibilities: Digital banner and social campaign creative

hero.alt: Bahlsen commercial spot showing a couple at home struggling to keep their Bahlsen snacks hidden from each other
hero.title: Secret Stash
hero.caption: Playful campaign highlighting the struggle of sharing snacks during lockdown

sections.title: Editing the commercial for a changed audience
paragraphs: I edited the 30-second commercial and designed supporting digital assets. After filming, the onset of COVID prompted a shift toward the experience of sharing snacks at home during lockdown, and I adapted the creative to the updated direction.
